title: 300,000 bats live under Waugh Drive
why: Cold, unaware Houstonians who have no idea the Waugh Drive bat colony exists or that it stays year-round; pattern interrupt that ends on the sunset bat tour.
hook_options: Houston's bats don't leave for winter
caption: An estimated 300,000 Mexican free-tailed bats live under the Waugh Drive Bridge, three miles from downtown, and they stay all year. Most people watch from the sidewalk. From a kayak they pour out right over you. Common at dusk, never guaranteed. #houstonbats #waughbridge #buffalobayou #buffalobayoukayak

slides.headline: 300,000 bats live under Waugh Drive
slides.body: An estimated 300,000 Mexican free-tailed bats. Year-round. Most Houstonians have driven right over them.

slides.headline: The Waugh Drive Bridge over Buffalo Bayou
slides.body: Just west of downtown. At dusk the colony pours out from under the bridge to hunt.

slides.kicker: Most people watch from up here
slides.headline: The sidewalk and the viewing platform
slides.body: It's free and it works. We're not going to pretend the bridge view is bad.

slides.headline: Water level, colony overhead
slides.body: From a kayak the bats pass right over you, downtown skyline behind them.

slides.headline: Bayou below, bridge above, bats everywhere
slides.body: Guests tell us it's the most unexpected thing they've done in this city.

slides.headline: They don't leave for winter
slides.body: Plenty of bat colonies fly south in fall. Houston's stays put. Summer flights are the most reliable, but the colony is here all year.

slides.headline: Common at dusk. Never guaranteed.
slides.body: Wild animals keep their own schedule. Weather and season move the timing. The skyline at dusk shows up regardless.

slides.headline: Launch from Allen's Landing before sunset
slides.body: Sunset Skyline Bat Bridge Kayak Tour. 2 to 3 hours, guide and gear included, ages 7 and up. No experience needed.

slides.headline: Herons, egrets, turtles, then the bats
slides.body: Guides point out what's moving along the bank on the paddle up. Wildlife is common, not guaranteed.

slides.headline: You've driven over them. Now paddle under.
slides.body: Sunset bat tours from Allen's Landing, 1019 Commerce St. Book at buffalobayoukayak.com.
